🎥🎬: I Play Rocky 

Before becoming one of Hollywood’s biggest stars, Sylvester Stallone was a struggling actor with little money and one dream—to tell the story of Rocky Balboa. Refusing to sell his screenplay unless he could play the lead, Stallone risked everything on a chance that seemed impossible.

The documentary follows the remarkable journey behind Rocky, showing how determination, rejection, and unwavering belief turned an unknown actor into a global icon. Through behind-the-scenes stories and personal reflections, it celebrates the making of one of cinema’s greatest underdog stories.
